purpose: Prevent percentages with different numerators, denominators, dates and scopes from being treated as one balance-sheet identity.

indicators.label: Post-election onshore retention
indicators.numerator: dollars bought for hoarding and deposited in the local financial system
indicators.denominator: dollars bought in the FX market for hoarding
indicators.nature: BCRA average; approximately USD 1.1 billion per month
indicators.warning: Not the same 75% as the regulatory lending ceiling.

indicators.label: Approximate current onshore retention
indicators.period: statement dated 2026-08-06, after data through July
indicators.numerator: dollars bought for hoarding and saved within the local financial system
indicators.nature: approximate figure in the BCRA president's opening remarks
indicators.warning: The speech does not disclose a bridge or exact calculation from the 75% post-election average.

indicators.label: Private USD loans / private USD deposits
indicators.numerator: approximately USD 24.6 billion in private-sector USD loans
indicators.denominator: approximately USD 40.3 billion in private-sector USD deposits
indicators.source_location: paragraphs describing stocks and lending ratio
indicators.warning: Rounded stocks yield approximately the published ratio.

indicators.label: Historical prudent lending reference
indicators.numerator: USD loans under the stated historical banking practice
indicators.source_location: 25% reserve plus about 10 percentage points of additional liquidity
indicators.warning: It is not a legal maximum.

indicators.label: Theoretical regulatory lending ceiling
indicators.source_location: official estimate of USD 30.5 billion capacity and USD 5.8 billion additional room
indicators.warning: Capacity is not demand, approval or disbursement.

indicators.label: Idle USD lending capacity
indicators.numerator: USD funding that could not be applied plus excess cash over regulatory reserves
indicators.warning: This is excess/idle capacity, not the full liquidity ratio.

indicators.label: Aggregate foreign-currency liquidity
indicators.numerator: aggregate foreign-currency liquidity under the banking-report definition
indicators.warning: It is broader than the 17% excess and uses a different perimeter from the 61% private loan/deposit ratio.

conclusion: The figures describe different flows, stocks and regulatory layers. They should be displayed side by side, not added or subtracted mechanically.
